summary.content:
Today's selection covers 53 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 36 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Krebs on Security, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 33 articles published in the last 24 hours
